motivation: The frozen V1 source trajectories use top-wall horizontal motion, while F6 target tasks use left-wall vertical motion. A square cavity is invariant under orientation-preserving 90-degree rotations; exact vector rotation augmentation tests whether this geometry shift caused transfer failure.

scope.source_validation: existing independent source-split HR validation trajectories only
scope.target_selection: existing four LR validation trajectories plus two fresh method V2 LR validation trajectories per task
scope.fresh_hr_confirmation_ic: streamfunction mode pairs (1,5) and (5,1), amplitude 0.035; generate separately and do not read before source/target checkpoint and evaluator freeze

rotation.selection: one deterministic-seed random orientation per whole source trajectory per epoch; all 20 transitions in that trajectory share the same orientation
rotation.coordinates: affine coordinates are rotated with the spatial field; viscosity and delta-t remain scalar
rotation.path_labels: selected PIMPLE first outer correction and matched endpoint labels receive the same physical vector rotation as endpoint training labels

training.target_scratch_control: one lifted LR-only scratch model per task, trained on the same four support trajectories and selected on the same six LR validation trajectories
training.source_model_and_optimizer: V1 6-layer width-48 FNO, AdamW lr=3e-4, weight_decay=1e-6, batch=8, 30 epochs, 2100 updates per arm
training.target_finetuning: NLT rank 4 alpha 4, endpoint-only LR support loss, AdamW lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-6, max 100 epochs, min 30, patience 12; matched scratch control uses the V1 lifted-FNO scratch optimizer schedule
training.target_checkpoint_selection: mean 20-step rollout relative-L2 over the existing four plus two fresh method V2 LR validation trajectories

interpretation.orientation_gap_reduced: rotated-source transfer improves F6 LR confirmation mean over the corresponding original V1 source arm and closes the F5/F6 gap
interpretation.pimple_guidance_supported_on_lr: rotated selected-PIMPLE-path source arm improves over both rotated final-only and rotated matched-endpoint source arms on F5 development and F6 LR confirmation means
interpretation.hr_claim: Any HR confirmation must use the separately generated fresh method V2 HR query set after global checkpoint/evaluator freeze; no V1 HR query may be reused.
